elements.element: Customer is not subject to any restriction on soliciting the other party's personnel.
elements.evidence: The clause expressly binds both parties, including Customer, not to solicit covered personnel.

elements.element: The non-solicitation restriction applies mutually to both parties on equivalent terms.
elements.evidence: The clause applies the same restriction and exceptions to “Neither party” and “either party.”

elements.element: The restriction is limited to personnel who were directly involved in the Services.
elements.evidence: It covers only personnel “who have had direct involvement with the Services.”

elements.element: For each covered person, the restriction expires no later than 12 months after that person's involvement in the Services ends.
elements.evidence: The restriction continues through the Agreement term and for one year after Agreement termination, rather than being measured from the end of each person's involvement. It may therefore last substantially longer than 12 months after that involvement ends.

elements.element: General advertisements and other recruiting efforts not specifically targeted at the other party's personnel are excluded from the restriction.
elements.evidence: New subsection (a) expressly permits general advertising and other recruiting efforts not specifically targeted at the other party's personnel.

elements.element: Hiring a person who responds to a permitted general advertisement or non-targeted recruiting effort is allowed.
elements.evidence: Subsection (a) expressly permits hiring any person who responds to those efforts.

elements.element: Unsolicited, candidate-initiated approaches are excluded from the restriction.
elements.evidence: Subsection (b) permits hiring a person who approaches a party on their own initiative without solicitation.

elements.element: Neither party is prohibited from hiring personnel independently of any prohibited solicitation.
elements.evidence: The operative prohibition is against “solicit[ing] for hire,” not hiring itself, and the added exceptions expressly permit hiring in the stated circumstances.

result.reason: The redline preserves the mutual, directly-involved-personnel scope and adds adequate general-advertising and unsolicited-approach carve-outs without creating a no-hire. It does not achieve the preferred position because Customer remains bound. It also fails the fallback because the 12-month period runs from Agreement termination rather than from the end of each person's involvement. Because no complete preferred or fallback level is reached, the redline is not minimal under the stated standard.
